relevance_note: Case report of a man with T1DM and HA20 carrying 'a c.1467_1468delinsAT heterozygous mutation in the gene TNFAIP3', plus a table of four previously published T1DM+HA20 patients.
method_note: Read the whole paper; built the JSON with a short Python script that cuts Table 2 row segments directly from the Markdown (cells checked by eye against the table). Table 2 has patients as columns; column header row is '|  | P1 | P2 | P3 | P4 | P5 |'. P5 is the case-report patient ('This study'); P1-P4 are previously published cases with reference numbers [13], [14], [14], [15] (reference list: [13] Duncan 2018 PMID:28659290; [14] Rossi 2022 PMID:35154120; [15] Deshayes 2021 PMID:33966343). 'NM' (not mentioned) recorded as not reported. Table 2 ages have no unit; ISO conversions assume years because P5's '19' matches the text 'at the age of 19 years'. CONTRADICTIONS: (1) the group statement 'these five patients did not present with ... arthralgia and arthritis, and recurrent fever' conflicts with Table 2 'Arthralgia yes' for P2 and P5; both rows emitted and the checklist item set to not reported for P2 and P5. (2) Protein change printed as 'p.Q490*' (text, Table 2) but 'p.Glu490*' in the Figure 1 legend (Q is the one-letter code for Gln, not Glu); recorded p.Q490*. (3) The same group statement says no 'early onset IBD', while P1 has 'enteropathy' listed under other autoinflammatory diseases; not treated as a direct contradiction (different terms), P1 GI checklist set observed from 'enteropathy'. (4) The abstract mentions only mouth ulcers; the case report says oral and genital ulcers. Group statement (names 'these five patients' = Table 2 P1-P5) used to exclude recurrent fever, arthritis and early-onset IBD (and arthralgia for P1). 'Other autoinflammatory diseases: no' (P3-P5) recorded as a feature row but not used to exclude cytopenia, GI inflammation or ILD. Normal values in Table 1 (blood counts, CRP 5.8 with range 0-6, RF) not converted into exclusions; ESR not reported; urine ketone cell '-' treated as not reported. Relatives: parents and sister tested negative for the variant; the paper does not distinguish the parents, so they are labelled 'parent 1' and 'parent 2'; parents described as 'healthy' (not recorded as a feature); no variant rows for relatives. P5 inheritance recorded 'de novo' because both parents tested negative; the paper does not use the words 'de novo'. Variant class for P1-P4 from 'nonsense or frameshift variants' plus the printed notation (fs vs *). Age at HA20 diagnosis for P5 is not stated (testing done at or after the admission at 39); T1DM diagnosis at 19 recorded as onset of the T1DM feature. n_patients_reported = 5 (1 new + 4 literature); the paper also mentions 117 literature cases without individual detail. Hashimoto thyroiditis treated as autoimmune thyroiditis for the checklist.
